lane_name: Transtensional Strain-Partitioning Mode x Seismic Swarm Excess x MT Clay-Cap Margin + 12-Bit LOCO Relay Mechanics & 300m Submodular Cover
single_method_summary: Target concealed geothermal-hosting faults in the Walker Lane - Basin & Range transition via the physical conjunction of (1) transtensional kinematic mode partitioning (sqrt(rank(geod_shearrate) * rank(max(geod_dilaterate, 0))) * (0.5 + 0.5*rank(geod_2ndinv))), (2) fluid-driven seismic swarm excess (rank(deq_n100a15) - 0.65*rank(ieq_n100a15)), (3) magnetotelluric clay-cap lateral conductance boundary perched over shallow conductive basement (|grad log1p(cond_surf)| * rank(-laplacian(depth_to_base_surf))), (4) DOE GDR 1391 chemical geothermometer disequilibrium & vent plumes coupled with magnetic demagnetization, and (5) missing-coverage-aware 1 m LiDAR scarp dipole & potential-field tilt zero-crossing bridges, integrated with strictly fold-visible 12-bit Leave-Own-Component-Out (LOCO) transtensional relay-corridor mechanics and emitted via exact 300 m triangular-kernel submodular coverage (37,654 binary dots, E=3 px catalogue collar).
named_non_fault_mimic: Non-tectonic volcanic or mining/quarry seismic swarms, evaporite/playa brine surface conductivity edges (e.g., Carson Sink / Humboldt Sink playas), and Pleistocene Lake Lahontan shoreline scarps.
inputs_allowed: data/processed/stack.npy (shared cached feature stack built by scripts/build_features.py)
forbidden_inputs: Any prior submission GeoTIFF (H19-5, H33, H77D, H77-Step, H78, etc.)
Withheld fault segments in any holdout fold

experiments.name: Feature Synthesis, Single-Feature Leakage Canaries & Standalone Surface Screen
experiments.description: Compute the 10 static H77-TSD channels and 5 fold-visible LOCO channels on seed=30; test symmetric ROC-AUC canaries on all 15 channels (hard stop if any > 0.90); score standalone label-free S_tsd_physics vs A0_random on gems57-pooled-hide-v2.

experiments.name: Dual-Seed Whole-Component Buffered Spatial Holdout & Ablation Benchmark
experiments.description: Evaluate A_tsd_full (OOF blend + 300 m submodular cover, 37,654 dots) vs A_tsd_greedy (same surface + greedy emit77), A_tsd_static_only (no LOCO mechanics), A_std_greedy (standard raw+terrain+rad HGB + emit77), and A0_random on Seed 30 (11,342 withheld positives) and Seed 20 (11,321 withheld positives) using unmodified vendor/gems57/evaluate_holdout.py.

experiments.name: Full-Map Out-of-Fold Candidate Build, Two-Phase 812-Registry + Local Uniqueness Audit & Portal Packaging
experiments.description: Build 4-quadrant OOF full-map H77-TSD surface (0 in-sample pixels), run Phase 1 pre-placement surface uniqueness and Phase 2 final-dot uniqueness across all 812 archive registry rasters + all local GEMSDOE77 rasters via vendor/gems57/uniqueness.py, write gems77-tsd-transtens-swarm-submod-37654dots-20261021-zeros.tif (.zip) via vendor/gems57/submission_writer.py, and verify with scripts/validate_submission.py.

promotion_and_uniqueness_policy.policy_i17_literal_dense_witness_rule: Under repository Policy I17, the full-footprint continuous witness ab0a0a62 forces literal 3-px forward overlap = 1.0 > 0.70 on every non-empty candidate. Therefore protocol_unique must be recorded as false and overall verdict/upload status must remain fail-closed ('negative' / 'NOT OK TO SUBMIT — inspection download only') even if scientific holdout and sparse dot-field uniqueness pass.
